text_block_list.text: We didn't achieve any results, did we?

text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I couldn't get it either, so there 
is no need to feel ashamed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"When things aren't working out, nothing 
will go right. Let's switch gears."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I recommend heading back and watching some 
cat videos or something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
